description: Full registry record for one wine: producer, region, appellation, classification, grapes, community rating, the AI tasting profile when the wine has been enriched, and the registry image (url + credit) when one is published — null means the wine has no public picture yet; to see the picture yourself, call get_photo with the wine_id. Vintage-neutral (bottles carry the vintage). For signed-in callers, pending_correction says whether a correction suggestion is awaiting review on this wine (one is allowed per wine, across all users), which fields it covers and whether it is the caller's own — check it before composing suggest_wine_correction. Call after search_registry when the user wants depth on a specific wine.

wine_id.description: Registry wine id from search_registry or a bottle's wine

name: get_wine
title: Get one registry wine
